info.title: ldapium management API
info.summary: HTTP API behind the ldapium web console, usable by scripts and AI agents with a session cookie.
info.description:
Authentication is a signed session cookie (`ldapium_session`) obtained from POST /api/login (LDAP mode) or the browser OIDC flow (SSO mode). There are no API tokens, no CORS headers and no machine principal yet; see docs/api.md and docs/changes/api-integration/PLAN.md.

Two error body shapes exist and are both documented: `{"error": string}` (directory/auth handlers via respondErr; 500s add `requestId`) and `{"message": string}` (validation, session, admin-gate, profile, backup, Keycloak). Unknown /api paths and wrong methods return `{"error": ...}` with 404/405.

Conditional writes use `ETag`/`If-Match` with quoted integer revisions (profiles, methods, backups) or a quoted 64-hex fingerprint (Keycloak role operations). Profile, method, backup and Keycloak write endpoints also enforce a same-origin `Origin` header and `Content-Type: application/json`.

Safety: `userPassword` is never returned by any endpoint. Operations marked destructive are not reversible. Directory writes run as the logged-in identity (LDAP mode) or the configured service account (SSO mode) under that identity's LDAP ACLs.

Public, cached for 5 minutes. Served from the binary, so it always matches the running build.
Used by the SPA and by the readiness probe; never touches LDAP.
Boolean only; the reason for a failure is never returned.

post.description: Binds to the directory as the given identity (full DN or bare uid) and sets the signed session cookie `ldapium_session` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax). Failed attempts are rate-limited per client IP. Disabled (404) when the server runs in SSO mode.

post.description: Always ends the local session and clears the cookie; no session is required. Returns 204 in LDAP mode. In SSO mode returns 200 with the IdP logout URL the browser should visit.

put.summary: Register or replace a custom integration method
put.description: Requires a session whose DN is in the profile administrator list (requireProfileAdmin); 404 when application profiles are disabled, 403 for other identities. Errors use the {"message"} shape. Write guard: the Origin header must equal the request's own scheme://host (else 403; scripted clients must set it). Request Content-Type must be application/json (otherwise 415). `If-Match` is the method's current revision as a quoted integer (`"0"` to create). Body `id` must equal the path and start with `custom-`; `revision` must be 0 (server-managed).

ETag.description: Revision validator; send it back in If-Match on the next write.

400.description: Invalid JSON, id mismatch, or revision supplied

500.description: Could not persist

put.summary: Create or update an application profile
put.description: Requires a session whose DN is in the profile administrator list (requireProfileAdmin); 404 when application profiles are disabled, 403 for other identities. Errors use the {"message"} shape. Write guard: the Origin header must equal the request's own scheme://host (else 403; scripted clients must set it). Request Content-Type must be application/json (otherwise 415). Optimistic concurrency: `If-Match` must be the profile's current revision as a quoted integer, `"0"` to create. Body `revision`, `status` and `deleted` are server-managed and must be omitted; body `id` must match the path.

ETag.description: Revision validator; send it back in If-Match on the next write.

requestId.description: Present on 500 responses; matches the X-Request-Id header and the server log line.

ErrorBody.description: Error shape produced by directory/auth handlers through respondErr.

EchoErrorBody.description: Error shape produced by validation, session, admin-gate, profile, backup and Keycloak handlers (Echo's default HTTPError).

ApiError.description: Either error shape. Clients should read `error` first, then `message`. The same status code can use either shape depending on where it was raised.

redirectURL.description: IdP end-session URL to visit; may be absent

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next page

x-ai-hints.authFlow: POST /api/login with a cookie jar, then reuse the jar. Check GET /api/v1/meta first for authMode; in sso mode scripted login is not possible.
x-ai-hints.writeSafety: Read before write: fetch the resource, take its ETag, send it as If-Match. Set Origin to the server's own origin on profile/backup writes.
